newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-ARMS PARK MEMORABILIA TO BE AUCTIONED.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ARMS PARK MEMORABILIA TO BE AUCTIONED.

text.p: Memorabilia in the form of turf, a pair of rugby posts and dozens of turnstiles will be among the items auctioned by the Welsh Rugby Union (WRU) next month as it dismantles its famous Cardiff Arms Park arena.
The WRU said in statement on Wednesday other items due to go under the hammer on April 27 included 20,000 stadium seats, the scoreboard, boilers and fixtures and fittings from the changing rooms.
The stadium is undergoing a 108 million pounds ($174.7 million) redevelopment in preparation for the 1999 World Cup.
